config.parameterization: block points scaled by w/shipCap, total renormalized to 110; sentiment raw = 0 in backtest (no historical feed); growth_ttm/margin_ttm are single-factor sector-percentile blocks on the ±35 scale, TTM computed per checkpoint from facts_quarterly + 10-K FY facts with the filed_at look-ahead guard

adoptionCriteria.rule: CLUSTER-robust: combos whose exact-tie cluster (differing only in blocks with identically-zero raw contribution — sentiment here) has positive mean Spearman in BOTH halves under the engine-exact rounded scorer for EVERY variant, plus the same criteria under the unrounded scorer; overall Spearman >= baseline + 0.10 and top-quintile-minus-middle > 0. The growth_ttm/margin_ttm blocks have NONZERO raw contribution in TTM-covered months, so variants differing in them are NOT exact ties — each must earn adoption on its own metrics; the winner additionally requires its neighbor variants (other grid levels of the same TTM blocks) to be reported for sign consistency. Rationale: variants that differ only in a zero-contribution block are the same ranking up to rounding tie-breaks — if the OOS sign depends on which variant you pick, it is not robust.
